text:
Distance Large Magellanic Cloud → Earth   
≈ 50 kpc ≃ 1.6 × 10⁵ light-years

Spacecraft speed  
v = 0.999 999 87 c ⇒ β = v/c = 0.999 999 87

1. Earth-frame travel time  
t₀ = distance / speed ≈ (1.6 × 10⁵ ly)/(0.999 999 87) ≈ 1.6 × 10⁵ yr

2. Lorentz factor  
γ = 1 / √(1 – β²)  
β = 1 – 1.3 × 10⁻⁷  
1 – β² ≃ 2 × 1.3 × 10⁻⁷ = 2.6 × 10⁻⁷  
γ ≃ 1 / √(2.6 × 10⁻⁷) ≃ 1 / (5.1 × 10⁻⁴) ≃ 1.96 × 10³

3. Proper time felt by astronaut  
τ = t₀ / γ ≃ (1.6 × 10⁵ yr) / (1.96 × 10³) ≈ 8.2 × 10¹ yr ≈ 82 yr

Hence the 22-year-old astronaut experiences about 8 × 10¹ years, arriving at age ≈ 104, well within the 150-year lifetime.

Closest choice: 81 years.

Answer: A
